user.title: Genvex Remote (experimental read-only)
user.description: Requires a separately installed private Genvex Nabto runtime App. Enter its internal snapshot endpoint and matching IPC token. Do not enter your Nabto account password here.

error.invalid_runtime_config: Enter the fixed Genvex Remote App URL (local-genvex-nabto-remote:18275) and a valid internal token.
